name: 3S Viking Status (classic, MIP)
author: Joakim
description: Tabbed Viking HUD panel fed by the BBE viking feed (MIP) - CLASSIC, frozen: for 3Scapes with MIP on; the Viking guild does not exist on 3K. The maintained GMCP line is '3S Viking Status (GMCP)' (3s-viking-status-gmcp) plus 3s-viking-sea and 3s-viking-kingdom. This classic and the GMCP plugins answer to the SAME commands (vgo, vmrun, build, mkref, atrade, ...) - enable one or the other, never both. Tabs: Stats / City / Builds / Production / People / Settlers / Holds / Sea / Voyage / Map / Travel / Plan / Mission / Trade / Trade Auto / Trade Log / Feeds. Includes the build planner and the market scanner + auto-trader, formerly the separate 3s-build and 3s-market plugins.
